name: Music Theatre of Connecticut Summer Theatre Programs
description_short: Musical theatre summer programs at Music Theatre of Connecticut in Norwalk. One-week half-day or full-day workshops for grades 2 to 8 rehearse a Broadway "show of the week" and perform it in the evening after the last rehearsal. A two-week production for grades 6 to 12 puts on an abridged 1.5-hour musical.
refund_policy_summary: $200 of tuition is non-refundable, and there are no refunds from April 1. Full policies are on the MTC Policies page.

source.title: Experience Our Summer Theatre Programs at Music Theatre of Connecticut | Norwalk, CT — Music Theatre of Connecticut
